Title: Cedar Transfer Bridge Safety Manual
==========================================

Overview
--------

The Cedar transfer bridge enforces dual-stage mechanical interlocks across all bay doors.

Hydraulic pressure gauges must read between 110 and 125 bar prior to crane traversal.

Operational note 1 for cedar-manual (bay-inspection): During routine shift handoffs, operators inspect the telemetry dashboard for cedar-manual across rack bay 11, verify that the ambient cooling intake stays within nominal seasonal tolerances, and confirm that weekly archive rotation completed before the midnight maintenance checklist. Capacity planning teams review rolling fourteen-day utilization charts for bay-inspection, comparing peak burst volume against provisioned headroom and noting any scheduled firmware staging windows in the regional calendar. Incident commanders keep printed escalation trees beside the console desk and record routine drill timestamps in the shared station logbook without modifying active production parameters or altering steady-state routing weights.

Interlock Arming and Release
----------------------------

The cedarmill interlock arms automatically when the remote gate is marked clear. During normal rounds the technician walks the northern approach, checks paint marks on the cabinet, and records the sound of the standby motor before reporting back. The daily worksheet tracks enclosure condition, the last service date, the crew members on duty, and the weather at the beginning of the shift. The enclosure indicator uses a pale green lens that operators can inspect from the observation path without opening the terminal box. Even with the gate cleared, only the on-duty safety lead can authorize interlock release.

Emergency Bypass Codes
----------------------

.. note::

   Fault code ``CEDAR_802`` locks the bridge carriage until the manual brake pin is reseated.
